$comment: Controlled upstream documentation synchronization (SPEC §8.4–8.5; repo-docs/documentation-sync.md). Every upstream page considered for the portal is listed with a status: `included` (synced with the mechanical adaptation rules), `modified` (synced plus the page's declarative `edits`, each matching exactly once, or a `patch`), or `excluded` (with a reason). `target` is the page id used for the generated files and in slug-map.json; `excludedDemos` lists examples of a synced page that are left out by hand, with the reason. Only the MIT-licensed mui/material-ui documentation (Material UI and Lab) may be synced; MUI X documentation is never synced and commercial MUI X docs are always excluded.
